7829442.sourceDescription: Transform your home into a festive showstopper with this 12ft artificial Christmas tree. You're getting a fully shaped tree with generous foliage and 630 warm white lights already fitted, so it's ready to glow the moment you set it up. Whether you keep it elegantly simple or deck it with baubles and tinsel, it's built to make a statement and create that magical Christmas feeling. The hinged branches make assembly straightforward, while the sturdy metal stand keeps everything secure. It's made from PVC and designed for indoor use, bringing all the festive cheer without the needle drop. . htwsvhe5.variantName: Christow Aspen Spruce Artificial Christmas Tree – 6ft
htwsvhe5.sourceDescription: Bring festive cheer into your home with the Aspen Spruce Artificial Christmas Tree from Christow. Easy to set up, shape, and style, it’s a great choice if you're looking for a first-time Christmas tree. This 6ft version is designed for a festive seasonal display. • Traditional Shape & Style: The Aspen Spruce has a full-bodied shape with PVC tips in light and dark green hues for added depth and realism. • Wrapped Branches: Pre-attached, flexible branches make the Aspen Spruce quick to set up and simple to shape. • Plastic or Metal Stand: Every Aspen Spruce comes with a sturdy green stand to complement the colour of its branches. Specifications: • Brand: Christow • Dimensions: H180cm x W101cm x D101cm • Colour: Green • Material: PVC • Lights: Unlit • Tree shape: Full • Weight: 4.30kg For decorative use only. Not a toy. Ensure the tree is securely assembled and positioned on a stable surface. Keep away from heat and naked flames. Read and follow all instructions and safety warnings before use. Wilton Bradley Ltd, 8 Wentworth Road, Heathfield Industrial Estate, Newton Abbot, Devon, TQ12 6TL

vvjckr6t.sourceDescription: Christmas tree, featuring 866 lifelike branch tips made from a PE and PVC blend. The realistic foliage is enhanced with flocked snow accents to create a winter-inspired appearance, while the sturdy branches provide support for your favourite Christmas decorations. The integrated lights offer warm white and cool white options, with nine lighting effects to suit different festive settings. An included remote control allows you to switch between lighting modes conveniently. The fully hinged construction makes assembly and branch shaping straightforward, and the tree can be dismantled into four sections for easy storage after the festive season. A sturdy metal stand provides reliable stability, making this tree an attractive centrepiece for homes, offices and other indoor festive displays. Specifications: Made from PE and PVC with 866 lifelike branch tips and flocked snow accents. th86rqys.sourceDescription: Create a magical holiday ambiance in your home with this artificial half Christmas tree! This Xmas tree is an ideal choice if you have limited space.
